'''Shadowbrak Ridge''' was a hilly and mountainous region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Shadowbrak Ridge is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" /> Shadowbrak was the nickname of ''Star Wars Galaxies'' developer [[Travis Hicks]].<ref>{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66960|text=Star Wars Galaxies Developer Chat Transcripts 2007}}</ref>
